frozenBeforeAnyOutcome: Written 2026-11-11 before the first cohort it governs exists. Nothing in it was chosen from a forward return; none exists for any arm.
doesNotAuthorize: writing any record to signal-history or any ledger outside research/evidence_first_v2/dry-run/
changing production, its receipts or the 2026-11 decision-desk ledger
calling any arm a verified or recommended portfolio

requires: an Owner approval file research/evidence_first_v2/owner-approvals/prospective-v1.json naming this protocol's SHA-256
every gate in research/decision_desk_v1/ledger.py ACTIVATION_GATES at RESOLVED
#321 merged so the repository's CI is green
activation.refusal: prospective.assert_activation_allowed() raises ACTIVATION_BLOCKED and lists what is missing

A_VERIFIED_STRATEGY.label: 검증된 실전 전략
A_VERIFIED_STRATEGY.entry: grade E5 in evidence-grades.json (which already requires an Owner approval reference) and no block state

B_PROSPECTIVE_VIRTUAL.label: 미검증 전향 가상 포트폴리오
entry: a pre-registered hypothesis whose rule is in this file (rule SHA-256 recorded on every record)

the rule's own evidence grade is at least E1 and its evidence-grades item lists no block in prospectiveBlocks (a block on NEW HISTORICAL research, such as KR GOVERNANCE_CLOSED, does not stop a prospective record)
every input fact was public strictly before the information cutoff (date-only receipts count from the next day)
every selected name has a price eligible for evaluation: a close on the decision date, no unresolved corporate action, no non-positive price
the record is committed and observed public before the registration deadline
B_PROSPECTIVE_VIRTUAL.neverLabelled: a verified strategy, a recommendation or a buy signal; the record says UNVERIFIED_PROSPECTIVE_VIRTUAL
B_PROSPECTIVE_VIRTUAL.graduates: to A only through E2-E4 evidence plus E5 Owner approval; accumulating records alone never promotes

C_WATCHLIST_ONLY.label: 단순 관심종목
C_WATCHLIST_ONLY.entry: a name someone wants to watch that fails any B condition (no pre-registered rule nominated it, inputs not PIT, price not eligible)
C_WATCHLIST_ONLY.recorded: never as a portfolio; no weight, no outcome

cohort.frequency: monthly, independent: each cohort is a separate buy-and-hold portfolio to its horizons; cohorts overlap and are never netted against each other
cohort.decisionDate: the asOfDate of the first FINAL_WEEKLY production receipt of the month in each region (KR and US separately)
cohort.informationCutoff: the regional close of the decision date (KR 15:30 Asia/Seoul, US 16:00 America/New_York)
cohort.recordedAt: the commit time of the cohort file, verified public before the deadline by an observation made before the deadline (ledger PUBLICATION rule)
cohort.registrationDeadline: the open of the execution session
cohort.execution: close of the first regional session whose open is at least 48 hours after the cohort packet is sealed; identical for all four arms
cohort.noBackfill: an arm that is not committed by the deadline is NO_RECORD for that cohort and is never filled in later

steps: universe: the census stage-3 survivors (common identity, tradable, 252 sessions of history, no unresolved corporate action)
inputs: the latest single filing, visible strictly before the decision date, that states ROE, operating margin, net margin and liabilities/equity, with a report period at most 456 days old
eligible: large cap (KR market-cap rank <= 150, US S&P 500), 0 < operating margin <= 1, liabilities/equity <= 2
rank by ROE (descending, ties by ticker); walk down the ranking and take a name unless its industry already holds 2 selected names; stop at 5
industry: KR = kr-industry-membership-foundation-v4 interval containing the decision date; US = pipeline.sectors.sector_of; an unknown industry is the shared bucket UNCLASSIFIED with the same cap
B1_ROE.nameNote: ROE is an in-house proxy motivated by the profitability literature; it is not the Fama-French OP or Novy-Marx GP/A strategy (data-integrity.json definitions)

PRODUCTION.rule: the weights of the FINAL_WEEKLY production receipt of the decision date, copied by digest

B1_PLUS_AI.rule: start from the B1_ROE selection; the AI review may only REMOVE names (decision EXCLUDE with at least two sourced reasons), never add or resize; survivors keep the B1 weight
B1_PLUS_AI.reviewContract: contract.validate_dossier: FACT rows generated from the census, no digit in AI text, counter-arguments and invalidation conditions required
B1_PLUS_AI.noReview: if no review is committed before the deadline the arm is NO_RECORD (never copied from B1, never back-filled)

portfolio.rebalance: none inside a horizon; a new cohort is a new portfolio
portfolio.perNameWeightNote: 10% is a fixed experimental convention carried from decision-desk protocol v1 so every arm is comparable; it is not an estimated optimum and no arm sizes by conviction

costs.basis: the production receipt's stated round-trip cost per leg (stock and ETF) on the decision date
costs.stress: 2x the same costs, reported beside the base case for every outcome

returns.definition: total return in local currency (KRW / USD), distributions reinvested at the ex-date close, entry at the execution close, exit at the close of the 126th and 252nd regional session
returns.benchmark: ETF100 of the same region and cohort on the same basis
returns.sourceBlocked: missing session, zero volume, non-positive price, unverified split, move beyond the daily limit, missing exit: SOURCE_BLOCKED, re-evaluated append-only when better data arrives, never 0%

comparison.primary: per cohort and horizon: B1_ROE - ETF100, B1_PLUS_AI - B1_ROE (the AI's marginal effect), PRODUCTION - ETF100, after base costs
comparison.excludedFromPrimary: records annotated PIT_CONTAMINATED, PUBLICATION_LATE or PUBLICATION_NOT_OBSERVED; they stay in the ledger and are reported separately
comparison.noEarlyClaim: no statement about an arm's edge before 24 cohorts have matured at 126 sessions; until then outcomes are listed, not summarised
